verdict.rationale: Because Open WebUI is self-hosted and can run fully offline/air-gapped, the user inherently controls where data lives, and docs explicitly describe manually adding, editing, or deleting memories via Settings > Personalization > Memory. However, there's no explicit documentation of conversation/chat history deletion, account-level data export/erasure, or a formal retention policy control panel. missing for 10: explicit chat/conversation deletion or bulk data export/erasure controls, documented retention policy settings, independent confirmation that deletion actually purges backend storage.
